d: Company Description EHOTBOX is a digital services provider offering automated digital marketing, SEO and SEM, and website and mobile application design and development. The company supports organizations with marketing research, management consulting, and both technical and non-technical training services. EHOTBOX delivers end-to-end telephony, email, SMS, IVR, USSD, call center services, and virtual mobile numbers, as well as shortcode and longcode solutions for two-way and mobile messaging. Its missed call services help run promotional campaigns, while CRM integration connects with platforms such as SugarCRM and Salesforce. EHOTBOX also provides database marketing across diverse sectors including banking, education, stock markets, IT, MLM, mutual funds, healthcare, real estate, insurance, financial products, advertising, and more.

Role Description This position is a Freelance position. The Channel Partner will work in a part-time, remote capacity to expand EHOTBOX’s reach and drive growth through strategic partnerships. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying prospective channel partners, presenting EHOTBOX’s service offerings, and negotiating partnership terms. The role involves coordinating with partners to support sales activities, tracking performance against agreed targets, and providing ongoing relationship management. The Channel Partner will collaborate with internal teams to align partner initiatives with business plans, gather market feedback, and help refine go-to-market strategies. Regular reporting on pipeline, partner engagement, and revenue outcomes will be expected.
q: Candidates should possess skills in Channel Partnership and Channel Sales to build, manage, and grow partner networks.
Candidates should already have a strong network of connections at the leadership level.
Candidates should possess skills in Business Planning and Sales to support market expansion and revenue generation.
Candidates should possess skills in Account Management to maintain strong, long-term partner relationships.
Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in digital marketing, SaaS, telecom, or related technology services is beneficial.
Candidates should be fluent in Arabic and English.
Ability to work independently in a remote, part-time setting and manage multiple partner accounts.
Prior experience in channel development or B2B sales is an advantage.
Relevant diploma or degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
